utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve only heard it’s a small handful so far, but I’ll check the sign-up table when I pass by and see how many can handle tools versus just setup or cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. If they still need an extra pair of hands, just let me know when and where.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading that way anyway, so I’ll let you know what they say and whether they need tool help or just setup and cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Vik, I’m still trying to track down that sign-up sheet, but Rey said they can lend a hand, which is a relief. Once I find where I put the thing, we ought to have enough folks for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s great news—I’ll keep telling folks the plan and let them know you’re tracking the sign-up sheet while Rey’s pitching in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. If I finally unbury that sheet from whatever pile I tucked it into, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, thanks—I've already lost track a bit, but I think Gus is bringing the toolkit, spare drill, and some screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—send me the full volunteer list when you have it, and I’ll confirm tonight. I’m still aiming for a 9 start if that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, 9 should work—I’ll pull the volunteer list together and send it over once I’ve double-checked I’m not missing anyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m set to bring my toolkit, the spare drill, and a box of assorted screws for the repair drive. If Eli knows of anything else we’re short on, I can probably dig that up too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds well covered, Gus. If you can add a few extension cords and some work gloves, we ought to be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Eli—I’ve got a couple extension cords and some work gloves I can bring too. That should round things out nicely.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still thinking late morning into early afternoon, around 10 to 2, for the repair drive. That should keep us clear of school pickup, and I’d really appreciate help coordinating around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That works great, Mara—I’ll start spreading the word for 10 to 2 and mention that we’re planning around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn—that helps a lot. If you can, please mention we’re keeping it 10 to 2 so pickup families can still make it comfortably.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t heard the final word yet, but they were leaning toward Saturday morning. I’m planning to check with Maya and can pass it along once she confirms.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules—that helps; when Maya confirms, let me know so I can line it up with the Maple and Cedar repair list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll check with Maya and send you the confirmed time as soon as I hear, so Maple and Cedar can stay in sync.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m sending Leo the volunteer names this afternoon, and he’ll confirm by tonight. Does a 9 o’clock start work for you too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: 9 works for me, Rosa—I’ll be there and I’m still keeping the tally on tape, gloves, and spare screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Cleo—thank you for keeping the supply tally organized. I’ll pass along that 9 works for you too, and we should be in good shape once Leo confirms tonight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—do you know if they’ve picked a day for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet, as far as I’ve heard. Have you heard anything firmer, or who’s supposed to confirm the date?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Nothing firm on my end either—I’d heard they might be aiming for Saturday morning, but I think Maya’s the one who’s supposed to confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s check that first—did the roof get moved ahead of the porch steps and fence, or are those still the priority?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure either—I just came in late, so let’s confirm whether the roof got bumped up before we decide anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, let’s pin that down first—can we check with the group whether the roof is now first, or if the porch steps and fence still come before it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and I heard they’re asking people to label anything they drop off now, which should keep it all a bit tidier if the heap keeps growing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That does help, though I’d still feel better if someone checked the labels against Mara’s sheet each evening. Once things start moving in and out of the shed, it’s awfully easy for bits to go astray.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, I think you’re right there—I did hear Ben say he’d go over the labels with Mara after supper tonight, just so nothing wanders off unnoticed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Faye, quick one—repair drive’s looking like Saturday at 10, and I’m bringing the basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That timing works well for me around the school run—I can help spread the word to pickup families and keep things lined up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—can you spread Saturday at 10, and I’ll keep the basic tools covered while I check if Malik’s still bringing the drill?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m ready to help, Kira—if we start with Maple and Cedar, I can walk Maple this afternoon and note the most urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe, but can you confirm we’re actually doing Saturday at 10 and who’s bringing which tools before we lock in Maple and Cedar?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can confirm Saturday at 10 works for me, and I’ll bring my ladder, hammer, and measuring tape so we can lock in Maple and Cedar.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
